newsitem.title: USA: Finish Line stake cut by Vinik group.
newsitem.headline: Finish Line stake cut by Vinik group.

text.p: A group led by former Fidelity Magellan Fund manager Jeffrey Vinik on Friday said it cut its stake in Finish Line Inc to 1,175,100 common shares, or 6.9 percent.
The group previously held 8.3 percent of Finish Line's shares.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 232,900 shares sold between February 26 and April 10 at prices ranging from $19.07 to $22.50 each.
Finish Line, based in Indianapolis, Ind., is a retailer of athletic footwear and clothing. Its shares closed down 1-3/4 at 16-3/8 on Friday.
